questions.prompt: A table gives model daily BERs of 5184 kJ at 40 kg and 7776 kJ at 60 kg. State the relationship, calculate how much higher the 60 kg estimate is, and give one limitation of the model. (3 marks)

markPoints.text: In the simplified model, predicted BER increases with mass.
A single simplified rate does not account for individual variation or activity/growth when estimating total needs.

answer.modelAnswer: In the simplified model, predicted BER increases with mass. 7776 − 5184 = 2592 kJ/day. A single simplified rate does not account for individual variation or activity/growth when estimating total needs.
